terbaru.judul: Differentially Private Sparse Reward Estimation with Preference Feedback
terbaru.pelajaran: In this work, we study \emph{Private Sparse RLHF} problem to address this limitation, assuming that human preferences (reward model) are governed by a subset of $s^* \ll d$ relevant features.

terbaru.judul: Flat-RLVR: Sharpness-Aware Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards for Reasoning Capacity in LLMs
terbaru.pelajaran: Our method, called \texttt{Flat}-RLVR, searches for flat reward regions via sharpness-aware minimization during LLM post-training, combining this with GRPO variants to achieve better trade-offs between sampling efficiency and reasoning capacity.

terbaru.judul: A Model-Free Continuous-Time RL Algorithm from Discrete-Time Off-Policy Data with End-to-End Guarantees
terbaru.pelajaran: In this paper, we study continuous-time reinforcement learning, where the state follows an unknown stochastic differential equation but only a fixed off-policy batch of discrete-time transitions is available.

terbaru.judul: Is Anyone Enforcing the Cartel? What Reinforcement Learning Teaches LLM Agents in Markets
terbaru.pelajaran: We introduce an audit that tests enforcement by forcing a member to cheat in counterfactual copies of a market, and use it to study what reinforcement learning (RL) teaches agents in pricing and trading.

terbaru.judul: Measure First, Then Allocate: Calibrated Rollout Budgets for MCP Agents in Reinforcement Learning
terbaru.pelajaran: Training tool-using language models requires costly interaction, yet identical rewards within a rollout group provide no group-relative learning signal.

terbaru.judul: Learning Adaptable Dexterous Skills via Hybrid Dexterous Mimicking
terbaru.pelajaran: We present AdaDex, a goal-conditioned RL framework that turns a single hand-object trajectory of a few seconds---from mocap data or HOI reconstruction from in-the-wild RGB(D) video---into an adaptable dexterous skill.

terbaru.judul: Interruption-Aware Recurrent Reinforcement Learning for UAS Navigation Under Temporary Overrides
terbaru.pelajaran: To address this vulnerability, we propose three interruption-aware architectures that condition recurrent processing on interruption context through separate feature streams, dedicated interruption memory, or gated environmental features.

terbaru.judul: Self-organizing reinforcement learning: a learner-free swarm approaches the explore-exploit optimum
terbaru.pelajaran: We show that a minimal foraging swarm approaches its optimum - the ideal-free / Nash allocation of a multi-agent resource-sharing game (an equilibrium, not a return maximum) - with no learner and no reward signal.

terbaru.judul: Pareto-Optimal RTL Code Generation via Multi-Objective Reinforcement Learning with Large Language Models
terbaru.pelajaran: In this work, we are the first to propose a learning method for LLM-based circuit generation that optimizes, not the quality of a single circuit, but the quality and diversity of the entire circuit set obtained through multiple generations in the PPA objective space.
